items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: it was the first time I was in Europe with Slam Stewart trio, with Earl Garner, myself and Slam.

ctx.x: Had Earl Garner recorded a lot then?

Well yes, he'd recorded -- you know he was with the Slam Stewart trio before that, before I joined him Earl was with Slam before -- let's see, who followed Earl. Billy Taylor. Errol was with Slam and the Slam Stewart before then. So he had quite a bit of exposure.

Yeah, I had seen -- the first time I'd seen Earl, my impression of Earl -- here I'm with Fletcher again. I went to -- Earl was from Pittsburgh, and we played Pittsburgh this night, and I went to a club and there was this little guy, this funny looking little man, this little funny looking genius sitting here playing.
